Registers on screen before he speaks. With features that resist easy categorization, he brings a physical presence that the camera finds and keeps. His range spans from grounded and honest to leading male magnetism with equal ease. This makes him a natural fit for narratives where presence is everything, from the charming love interest that carries the room to the renegade soldier who holds the line in a world come undone.
